purpose: The service tokenizes primary account numbers (PANs) for payment services and stores tokens instead of PANs.

components.name: tokenization-service
components.evidence: tokenize (PAN in, token out) and detokenize (token in, PAN out).

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: encrypted card records and the token mapping.

components.name: Vault and KMS
components.evidence: data encryption keys and runtime secrets.

flows.evidence: Calls from payment services to the tokenization-service are authenticated with mutual TLS or signed workload identity tokens.
The tokenizer (tokenization-service, I say tokenizer) takes a PAN, encrypts it with a data key from Vault and KMS, writes it and gives a token back.
The tokenizer sends token lifecycle events (created, rotated, revoked) to the payment services as callbacks.
